_format: Goals page of the journal (Act 1). One line per goal, shown while active: where/what, never how (no lever sides, riddle answers or plate orders). Fields: id, floor (0 = whole act), optional (shown in grey, never blocks), text, set_on, done_on, fail_on (struck through as lost), replaces (hides that goal when this one is set). Events are trigger keys from story/triggers_act1.json (log/bark/dialogue/puzzle keys) or flags. Done goals tick and move to the bottom; they clear at the next floor. Tapping a goal opens the Map tab on that floor (not the square). Goal state lives in the save slot. New goal: log goal_new. UI labels: ui_text journal. Greek: story/el/goals_act1.el.json, same ids.

goals.text: Find out why the keep is still dry.
Mags's brother Tam came here last spring. Find him.
Find a way down from the upper halls.
A locked door in the upper halls. Its key is close.
Someone is shouting from the stores.
The cistern is flooded. The stairs lie past it.
Tam's voice came from below the barracks.
Tam is somewhere in Barracks Deep. Find the cells.
The captain's hall is sealed by a riddle.
The cell wing is locked. The captain has the key.
